name: watchtower
description: Production-grade remote operations with audit logging. Safe commands for SSH, kubectl, filesystem operations with centralized logging and mutation alerts.

manual_call_templates.name: remote-safe
manual_call_templates.description: Scoped remote system operations with audit logging (ssh, kubectl exec, rg, jq, filesystem)

tools.name: ssh_ls
tools.description: Read-only directory listing via SSH with audit logging

tools.name: ssh_cat
tools.description: Read file contents via SSH with audit logging

tools.name: ssh_ps
tools.description: List processes on remote host via SSH

tools.name: kubectl_exec_read
tools.description: Read-only kubectl exec commands (cat, ls, ps, df, top) with audit logging

tools.name: kubectl_get_yaml
tools.description: Get kubernetes resource as YAML with audit logging

tools.name: kubectl_logs
tools.description: Get pod logs with audit logging

tools.name: rg_search
tools.description: Safe ripgrep search (no --replace, no --exec) with audit logging

tools.name: jq_query
tools.description: Safe JSON processing (read-only queries) with audit logging

tools.name: safe_rm
tools.description: Safe file/directory removal with audit logging (blocks protected paths)

args: case '${path}' in /|/home|/etc|/var|/usr|/root|/bin|/sbin|/lib|/opt) echo 'BLOCKED: protected path' >&2; exit 1;; esac; CMD=$(case '${mode}' in file) echo 'rm -f';; dir) echo 'rmdir';; dir-recursive) echo 'rm -rf';; esac); $CMD '${path}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] rm ${mode}: ${path}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_mkdir
tools.description: Safe directory creation with audit logging

args: if [ '${mode}' = 'parents' ]; then mkdir -p '${path}'; else mkdir '${path}'; fi 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] mkdir ${mode}: ${path}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_touch
tools.description: Safe file creation/timestamp update with audit logging

args: if [ -n '${timestamp}' ]; then touch -t '${timestamp}' '${path}'; else touch '${path}'; fi 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] touch: ${path}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_mv
tools.description: Safe file/directory move with audit logging

args: FLAG=$(case '${mode}' in no-clobber) echo '-n';; force) echo '-f';; backup) echo '-b';; esac); mv $FLAG '${source}' '${dest}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] mv ${mode}: ${source} -> ${dest}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_cp
tools.description: Safe file copy with audit logging

args: FLAG=$(case '${mode}' in no-clobber) echo '-n';; force) echo '-f';; backup) echo '-b';; archive) echo '-a';; esac); cp $FLAG '${source}' '${dest}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] cp ${mode}: ${source} -> ${dest}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_chown
tools.description: Safe ownership change with audit logging (restricted combinations)

args: RFLAG=$(if [ '${recursive}' = 'yes' ]; then echo '-R'; fi); chown $RFLAG '${owner}' '${path}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] chown ${owner} (recursive=${recursive}): ${path}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_chmod
tools.description: Safe permission change with audit logging (safe modes only)

args: RFLAG=$(if [ '${recursive}' = 'yes' ]; then echo '-R'; fi); chmod $RFLAG '${mode}' '${path}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] chmod ${mode} (recursive=${recursive}): ${path}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log

tools.name: safe_ln
tools.description: Safe symlink creation with audit logging

args: FLAG=$(case '${mode}' in soft) echo '-s';; force-soft) echo '-sf';; esac); ln $FLAG '${target}' '${linkpath}' 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/watchtower/fs.log; echo "[WATCHTOWER] ln ${mode}: ${target} -> ${linkpath}" >> /tmp/watchtower/fs.log
